  • Start Date : 16/04/2026
  • Last Date : 10/05/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 11/05/2026

  • Exam Date : 07/06/2026
  • Exam City Available : 28/05/2026

  • Result Declared Date : As Per Schedule
  • Download Admit Card : Click Here

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 16/04/2026
  • Last Date : 10/05/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 11/05/2026

  2. Click on the answer key link.

  4. Download the answer key PDF.
  5. Calculate your expected marks and raise objections if any by the specified deadline.
